subject: Mutual action plan: commitment, PO cutoff & signature runway
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ramos <claire.ramos@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: commitment, PO cutoff & signature runway

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP-draft-Acme-20270418.pdf) that captures the milestones we discussed and proposed owners. High-level items to confirm: 

- Target close date: proposed 2027-05-20 (customer PO issued and contract countersigned)
- Procurement / PO cutoff: we recommended 2027-05-10 as the internal procurement cutoff at ACME to allow legal review and SSO onboarding
- Legal review window: ACME legal to provide redlines by 2027-05-12 to keep the runway
- Pilot kickoff: provisioned environment + SSO test by 2027-06-01

Action items for you (next steps):
1) Can you confirm whether the procurement cutoff of 2027-05-10 is realistic for your procurement team?
2) Please share the intended PO approver and any additional procurement contacts so we can loop them into the MAP.
3) If legal needs a distinct timeline, let us know — we'll adjust the MAP so dates don't slip.

I've CC'd Ben (pricing and contracts) and Marissa (CS/implementation) to keep stakeholders aligned. If those dates don't work, propose an alternate close that meets your internal board cadence and procurement windows.

Attachments: MAP-draft-Acme-20270418.pdf (attached, 1 page — milestones + owners)

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Claire Ramos <claire.ramos@acme-retail.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: commitment, PO cutoff & signature runway

Ava — thanks for the recap and the draft MAP. Quick notes from procurement & legal: 

- Procurement confirms internal PO cutoff of 2027-05-11 (one day later than your ask) — our review queue is heavier that week.
- Legal flagged two items in section 3 (data retention + audit logs) and asked for a 3-business-day review window after we receive the final contract. They indicated this may push countersign to 2027-05-21 if we get the contract on 2027-05-12.

I added Procurement (procurement@acme-retail.com) and Legal (legal@acme-retail.com) to keep them in the loop.

For now, we can aim for target close week of 2027-05-17 and treat 2027-05-20 as optimistic if legal finishes earlier.

Claire Ramos
Head of Data & Analytics | Acme Retail
claire.ramos@acme-retail.com

Subject: RE: Mutual action plan: commitment, PO cutoff & signature runway — agreed next steps

Claire / Procurement / Legal — thanks for the quick turnaround and context. Per the thread, here's the agreed MAP update so everyone has a single source of truth: 

- Final target close: 2027-05-21 (contract countersigned) — accommodated to allow legal's 3-business-day review after 2027-05-12 contract delivery.
- Procurement PO cutoff at ACME: 2027-05-11 (procurement team confirmed) — Redwood will accept POs received up to EOD 2027-05-11 for the May close.
- Contract delivery date: Redwood to send final SOW & contract for legal review by 2027-05-12 EOD. 
- Discount & finance approvals: Ben will confirm by 2027-05-13 whether any price adjustments apply; if none, invoice will reflect standard committed pricing.
- Pilot kickoff: target 2027-06-07 (Marissa to own implementation sequencing).

Please reply to confirm acceptance of the dates above. I've attached an updated MAP (MAP-updated-Acme-20270420.pdf) that reflects these changes and assigns milestone owners. Also linking the HubSpot deal and the shared MAP doc for reference.

Attachments: MAP-updated-Acme-20270420.pdf (attached, 2 pages — updated dates & owners)

Thanks — looking forward to closing this together.
